articles.title: UP Shock: Banda Hotel Owner Accused of Forcing Woman into Flesh Trade, Police Launch Probe
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In Banda district of Uttar Pradesh, a woman employee of Shyam Darbar Restaurant and Hotel has accused owner Yogesh Shukla of attempting to push her into the flesh trade. She alleged that she was pressured to travel to Delhi with promises of earning ₹5,000–₹10,000 per day.

body.html:
In Banda district of Uttar Pradesh, a woman employee of Shyam Darbar Restaurant and Hotel has accused owner Yogesh Shukla of attempting to push her into the flesh trade. She alleged that she was pressured to travel to Delhi with promises of earning ₹5,000–₹10,000 per day.

Serious allegations also surfaced regarding “couple sex” being facilitated inside the hotel’s cabins. After a video of the claims went viral, Banda police swung into action.

ASP Banda has been assigned to investigate the matter. Police confirmed that under Kotwali Nagar PS jurisdiction, a case has been registered based on the victim’s complaint under relevant sections. Legal action is underway.

articles.title: Jaipur Road Rage Horror: Labourer Crushed to Death by Scorpio, Locals Outraged
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking case of road rage rocked Jaipur’s Murlipura on Saturday evening, August 16. Chandrashekhar (35), a labourer from Uttar Pradesh, was crushed to death by a Mahindra Scorpio after a car collision escalated into violence near Khatushyamji temple on Sikar Road.

body.html:
A shocking case of road rage rocked Jaipur’s Murlipura on Saturday evening, August 16. Chandrashekhar (35), a labourer from Uttar Pradesh, was crushed to death by a Mahindra Scorpio after a car collision escalated into violence near Khatushyamji temple on Sikar Road.

Eyewitnesses said four to five youths from the Scorpio vandalised a Maruti Brezza with sticks, drawing a crowd. In the chaos, Chandrashekhar fell onto the road and was deliberately run over as the miscreants fled. He was declared dead at Kanwatia Hospital.

The incident, caught on CCTV, has gone viral, sparking public anger. Locals alleged the Scorpio bore a political party flag, though police said this is under investigation. A case of unintentional murder has been registered, and a manhunt for the accused is underway.

This comes just days after a retired army officer died in another Jaipur road incident, raising alarm over rising road rage cases.

articles.title: Greater Noida Fire Exposes Illegal Shops in Supertech Ecovillage 2, Goods Worth Lakhs Destroyed
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Greater Noida: A massive fire broke out in the market of Supertech Ecovillage 2 Society in Greater Noida West, gutting an ATM and several adjoining shops. The blaze was so intense that shopkeepers rushed to save their goods while attempting to douse the flames.

body.html:
Greater Noida: A massive fire broke out in the market of Supertech Ecovillage 2 Society in Greater Noida West, gutting an ATM and several adjoining shops. The blaze was so intense that shopkeepers rushed to save their goods while attempting to douse the flames. Fire department teams reached the spot and brought the fire under control, but goods worth lakhs were reduced to ashes.

Locals allege that the shops were set up illegally inside the society premises. This incident has once again highlighted the growing issue of unauthorised shops in Greater Noida West, allegedly running with the collusion of builder managements and Apartment Owners Associations (AOAs).

Similar complaints were earlier raised in Ajnara Homes Society, where Greater Noida Authority had sealed multiple shops and ordered others to be removed. However, residents claim that after initial action, no strict follow-up was taken.

articles.title: Son Thrashes Mother With Slipper Over Liquor Money, Police Call It ‘Family Dispute’ in Hardoi
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Hardoi: A shocking video from Pali town of Hardoi district went viral on social media, showing a son brutally beating his mother with a slipper. The mother’s only fault was reportedly her refusal to give him money for alcohol.

body.html:
Hardoi: A shocking video from Pali town of Hardoi district went viral on social media, showing a son brutally beating his mother with a slipper. The mother’s only fault was reportedly her refusal to give him money for alcohol.

However, Hardoi Police issued a clarification, stating that the incident occurred on 16th August in Mohalla Sheikhsarai under Pali police station limits and was part of a family dispute over water. Police registered an FIR (No. 3541255) on the complaint of Smt. Rajni, wife of Narendra, and arrested two accused—Manjesh and Ranjeet, both sons of Narendra, residents of the same locality.

The arrests were made by Station Incharge Sompal Gangwar, Sub-Inspector Akanksha Singh, and Constable Gurjeet Singh. Police confirmed that further legal action is underway.

articles.title: Pune Horror: 21-Year-Old Biker Crushed by Falling Iron From Flyover, Critical in ICU
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Pune – A shocking accident occurred on Thursday afternoon in Pimpri-Chinchwad’s Bhosari flyover, where heavy iron pieces fell onto a motorcyclist after a tempo collided with the flyover wall.

body.html:
Pune – A shocking accident occurred on Thursday afternoon in Pimpri-Chinchwad’s Bhosari flyover, where heavy iron pieces fell onto a motorcyclist after a tempo collided with the flyover wall.

The injured has been identified as Ritesh Ghogare (21), a resident of Bhosari, who was on his way to Chakan for work. CCTV footage shows the iron tumbling down, striking him and leaving him unconscious on the spot. Locals rushed him to hospital, where he remains in the ICU.

Preliminary police probe suggests the tempo, possibly overloaded, failed to climb an incline and rolled back, hitting the flyover wall and dislodging the iron.

The incident triggered panic in the area as police and emergency teams arrived to secure the spot. An investigation is ongoing.

articles.title: Massive Gas Pipeline Blast in Yamuna Sends Water 30 Feet High, Panic in Baghpat Villages!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Baghpat, UP – On Saturday, August 16, 2025, a major burst occurred in the Indian Oil Corporation’s Dadri–Panipat Natural Gas Pipeline running under the Yamuna river in Baghpat district.

body.html:
Baghpat, UP – On Saturday, August 16, 2025, a major burst occurred in the Indian Oil Corporation’s Dadri–Panipat Natural Gas Pipeline running under the Yamuna river in Baghpat district.

The explosion was so powerful it shot water 30–35 feet into the air, creating panic in nearby villages, including Katha and Mavikala.

Officials suspect the rupture was caused by a heavy stone striking the pipeline in floodwaters, though the exact cause will be confirmed after inspection.

No casualties were reported. IOC immediately shut gas supply through the damaged line and diverted it via alternate routes to avoid disruption. Repair operations are underway with officials and engineers securing the site.

The dramatic water eruption drew crowds, but police and local administration maintained order. Authorities said the situation is now under control.

articles.title: Tragedy Near Humayun’s Tomb: 5 Dead, 5 Injured as Dargah Wall Collapses in Delhi
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: New Delhi – At least five people were killed and five others injured on Friday evening after a portion of the roof and wall of Dargah Sharif Patte Shah collapsed near Humayun’s Tomb in Nizamuddin. Police said they received a distress call around 3:55 PM.

body.html:
New Delhi – At least five people were killed and five others injured on Friday evening after a portion of the roof and wall of Dargah Sharif Patte Shah collapsed near Humayun’s Tomb in Nizamuddin.

Police said they received a distress call around 3:55 PM. A total of 11 victims were pulled out from the debris and rushed to hospitals, including AIIMS Trauma Centre and LNJP Hospital.

Rescue teams from Delhi Police, Fire Services, NDRF, and DDMA were deployed immediately. “The SHO and local staff reached the site within minutes. Fire personnel, CATS ambulances, and later NDRF joined the operation,” a senior officer told PTI.

Officials clarified that Humayun’s Tomb itself was not damaged. Ratish Nanda of the Aga Khan Trust for Culture, which oversees restoration, said a newly built structure near the tomb collapsed, with debris falling on its boundary wall.

Delhi Traffic Police diverted routes to ensure ambulances reached hospitals without delay. Rescue operations were continuing till late evening.
